title: Atypical haemolytic uraemic syndrome
diseaseDescription: Bounded complement-mediated aHUS: inherited or acquired complement dysregulation at endothelial surfaces, terminal complement injury and thrombotic microangiopathy. Human cohorts, endothelial assays and animal experiments remain distinct. Excludes STEC-HUS, TTP, secondary TMA, DGKE and cobalamin-related TMA. Selected genetic, antibody, endothelial-assay and terminal-pathway studies only. Factor B, THBD, triggers and full clinical manifestation sequence remain deferred rather than inferred.
releaseNote: Agent-curated local candidate; independent scientific review and calibration pending. Abstract access predominates; notice-linked factor B and ravulizumab primary results deferred pending correction appraisal.

entities.label: Complement-regulatory gene variants
entities.description: Selected CFH, CFI and CD46 susceptibility variants; variant-specific functional evidence and incomplete penetrance are retained.

entities.label: Factor H regulatory activity
entities.description: Surface recognition and complement regulation; patient autoantibody binding and inhibition are studied in biochemical assays.

entities.label: Anti-factor H autoantibodies
entities.description: Patient antibodies to factor H; studied C-terminal binding inhibits surface recognition.

entities.label: CFHR1/CFHR3 deficiency
entities.description: Inherited deficiency associated with anti-factor H autoantibodies in a selected cohort; not sufficient by itself to establish disease.

entities.label: Factor I regulatory activity
entities.description: Complement protease activity; selected CFI variants impair secretion or surface C3b cleavage.

entities.label: CD46 surface regulation
entities.description: Membrane cofactor protein function; R69W/A304V cell challenge experiments retain variant and model limits.

entities.label: C3 susceptibility variants
entities.description: Selected C3 variants in a low-C3 patient series; both gain-of-function and inactivating variants were reported.

entities.label: Alternative complement pathway dysregulation
entities.description: Failure to regulate alternative complement activity; fluid phase and endothelial-surface readouts are distinct.

entities.label: aHUS patient serum
entities.description: Patient serum sampled during acute disease or remission, tested on human endothelial cells.

entities.label: Endothelial C5b-9 deposition
entities.description: Terminal complement membrane attack complex on endothelial surfaces; assay readout is not equivalent to clinical disease.

entities.label: C5a–C5aR1 signalling
entities.description: Terminal complement inflammatory signalling, genetically and pharmacologically perturbed in distinct mouse models.

entities.label: Renal thrombotic microangiopathy
entities.description: Renal small-vessel pathology in mouse experiments; human trial outcomes use their specified TMA definitions.

entities.label: Macrovascular thrombosis
entities.description: Separate outcome in factor H mutant mice; not substituted for renal TMA or universal human disease.

entities.label: aHUS susceptibility / penetrance
entities.description: Human genetic association and incomplete penetrance; not a deterministic genotype-to-disease pathway.

entities.label: Eculizumab exposure
entities.description: C5 inhibitor exposure in endothelial assays and separate uncontrolled clinical trials.

entities.label: Clinical TMA response
entities.description: Trial-specific platelet and TMA event-free outcomes; not identical across studies.

entities.label: Loss of kidney function
entities.description: Renal impairment or recovery endpoints in selected aHUS trials; reversal is not assured.

claims.text: IgG from five unrelated aHUS patients inhibited factor H binding to C3b in a functional assay.
limitations: Sheep-erythrocyte hemolysis experiments do not directly demonstrate human renal endothelial injury.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: In 147 aHUS patients, 16 juvenile autoantibody-positive patients had absent or very low CFHR1/CFHR3.
limitations: Association does not establish that deletion causes autoantibodies or that deficiency is sufficient for aHUS.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Among 795 aHUS patients, single complement-gene mutations were detected in 41% and combined mutations in 3%.
limitations: Historical mutation classification and selected ascertainment; current variant reclassification not performed.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Penetrance among combined-mutation carriers differed with CFH/MCP risk haplotypes: 73% with two versus 36% with zero or one.
limitations: Susceptibility variants do not determine clinical disease; estimates are cohort-specific.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: In expression and endothelial assays, selected CFI variants impaired secretion or surface C3b degradation relative to wild type.
limitations: Variant-specific function; not every CFI variant is pathogenic or has the same defect.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Cell lines expressing CD46 R69W or A304V controlled alternative-pathway surface activation less effectively than wild-type protein.
limitations: Mixed clinical phenotypes in the report; functional impairment alone does not establish aHUS-specific pathogenicity.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Nine novel C3 mutations were described in 14 selected aHUS patients with persistently low C3.
limitations: Not a prevalence estimate for unselected aHUS.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: The C3 series reported five gain-of-function and two inactivating mutations, qualifying any uniform gain-of-function interpretation.
limitations: Not all identified variants were shown to have the same functional consequence.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Acute aHUS serum induced greater C3 and C5b-9 deposition than control serum on unstimulated HMEC-1.
limitations: Culture deposition cannot be interpreted as a validated clinical activity test.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: On ADP-activated HMEC-1, serum from unaffected mutation carriers also induced excessive complement deposition.
limitations: Abnormal assay response is not sufficient for clinical aHUS and depends on cell activation.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Acute-phase sera from five aHUS patients increased C5b-9 deposition on glomerular microvascular endothelial cells.
limitations: Small sample and culture model; magnitude did not perfectly track clinical severity.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Remission samples normalized C5b-9 deposition with or without ongoing eculizumab complement blockade.
limitations: Qualifies disease-activity and drug-response interpretation; assay is not sufficient to infer treatment need.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Eculizumab dose-dependently inhibited activated-serum C5b-9 deposition on glomerular endothelial cultures.
limitations: Zymosan may also activate endothelial cells; no clinical efficacy estimate from this experiment.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: In C3 D1115N mice, C7 deficiency abolished clinical and histological disease, supporting a requirement for MAC in that model.
limitations: Mouse-model causal evidence; does not establish anti-C7 clinical efficacy or universal human dependence.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: C5aR1 removal attenuated clinical disease risk in C3 D1115N mice but renal TMA still developed.
limitations: C5aR1 contribution is model-specific; not equivalent to MAC blockade.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: C6 or C9 deficiency markedly diminished renal TMA in factor H W1206R mutant mice.
limitations: Aged deficient mice developed C3GN-like disease; terminal blockade does not normalize all upstream biology.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: C5aR1 deficiency prevented macrovascular thrombosis in factor H mutant mice.
limitations: Macrovascular thrombosis is a distinct mouse outcome; not a claim of universal human aHUS manifestations.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: C5aR1 deficiency did not reduce renal TMA or improve survival in factor H mutant mice.
limitations: Null renal outcome qualifies pathway generalization; differs from clinical-risk attenuation in the C3 model.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: In two prospective uncontrolled eculizumab phase 2 studies, platelet counts improved and 80% in the second trial achieved TMA event-free status.
limitations: No concurrent randomized comparator; event-free status differs from complete TMA response.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.

claims.text: Renal function improved during eculizumab treatment; four of five baseline dialysis patients in trial 1 discontinued dialysis.
limitations: Small selected cohorts; no guarantee of renal recovery and no untreated comparator.
Selected primary-source inspection by an agent; independent domain review pending.
